package.author: The wasmCloud Authors
package.description: The wasmCloud Shell (wash) - a CLI for building, running, and managing WebAssembly components and wasmCloud applications.

en-US.author: The wasmCloud Authors
en-US.description: The wasmCloud Shell (wash) - a CLI for building, running, and managing WebAssembly components and wasmCloud applications.
en-US.longDescription:
wash is the wasmCloud Shell, a single CLI tool for working with WebAssembly components and wasmCloud.
- Build WebAssembly components from multiple languages with `wash build`
- Iterate quickly with a live dev loop using `wash dev`
- Run a local wasmCloud host and deploy applications
- Manage plugins and WIT interfaces
en-US.name: wash
en-US.releaseNotes:
What's Changed
- ci: max scale release bench by @vados-cosmonic in #5875
- fix(bench): run max scale with growth and show its memory limit by @vados-cosmonic in #5876
- fix(operator): report DaemonSet progress after partial deletions by @ricochet in #5874
- fix(wash-runtime): enable ulid for bind generations without PostgreSQL by @ricochet in #5878
- ci: publish OSPS Baseline results to grc.store by @ricochet in #5881
- security: publish and attest OpenVEX release assessments by @ricochet in #5880
- refactor(gateway): use slog and cover startup lifecycle by @ricochet in #5877
- docs: add architecture and interface docs for OSPS Baseline evidence by @ricochet in #5882
- fix(wasmbus): allocate request defaults per message by @ricochet in #5868
- fix(wash-runtime): keep an unsent request body writable for the guest by @ricochet in #5848
- ci: dispatch the TypeScript release from release-tag by @ricochet in #5887
- perf(wash-runtime): take the async-lock and blocking-pool waits off workload starts by @Aditya1404Sal in #5749
- perf(wash-runtime): lock HTTP route writers per shard, not per router by @Aditya1404Sal in #5746
- feat(wash): allow configuring the host ID by @ricochet in #5885
- ci: raise the check timeout to 75 minutes by @ricochet in #5889
- ci: stop buildx cache writes from evicting the Rust caches by @ricochet in #5890
- ci: dispatch private parser fuzzing from the release train by @ricochet in #5856
- test(operator): cover startup, controller registration and deep-copy isolation by @ricochet in #5891
- fix(wash-runtime): refresh client identity on new TLS connections by @ricochet in #5888
- ci: harden private parser fuzzing and pin the promoted release commit by @vados-cosmonic in #5893
- fix(operator): correct workload placement and cover its lifecycle by @ricochet in #5886
- fix(runtime-operator): bind heartbeats to subject identity by @ricochet in #5884
- fix(wash-runtime): guest postgres, OTel and NATS inputs that stall, panic or skip TLS by @ricochet in #5894
- security: pin release attestation checks to release-tag on main by @ricochet in #5895
- fix(bench): install docker-buildx so k6bench can build images from source by @ricochet in #5896
- fix(wash-runtime): harden native plugin egress checks by @ricochet in #5897
- bench(wash-runtime): add container memory pressure coverage and sizing guide by @ricochet in #5816
- fix(bench): memory pressure follow-ups by @vados-cosmonic in #5902
- fix(wash-runtime): read the footprint on every start past the high-water mark by @vados-cosmonic in #5904
- fix(bench): name the refusing budget and keep pressure logs plain by @vados-cosmonic in #5903
- feat(bench): pass runner args to memory_pressure from the bench workflow by @vados-cosmonic in #5905
- feat(bench): run the bench pipeline on short-lived hosts by runner label by @ricochet in #5906
- test(wash): keep the older-prerelease update case older on prerelease builds by @ricochet in #5907
- feat(chart): place host groups with nodeSelector and tolerations by @ricochet in #5900
- test(runtime-operator): raise branch coverage above 80% by @ricochet in #5899
- ci: run every .github/scripts node test in lint-workflows by @ricochet in #5908
- test(runtime-operator): move RPC tests out of the buf output tree by @ricochet in #5912
- feat(bench): publish every bench host's results by @ricochet in #5909
- fix(k6bench): raise k6's GOGC so its GC doesn't stall the stress steps by @ricochet in #5910
- chore: assign scripts/k6bench to ci maintainers in CODEOWNERS by @ricochet in #5911
- perf(wash-runtime): remove the global UUID sequence lock by @ricochet in #5914
- ci(gpubench): dispatch gpubench from main, with publish_pr by @ricochet in #5919
- refactor(operator,gateway): use stdlib errors, JSON, and shared slog logging by @ricochet in #5883
- fix(bench): parallelize density load without exceeding concurrency by @ricochet in #5918
- chore(deps): Bump the all-github-actions group across 2 directories with 2 updates by @dependabot[bot] in #5921
- chore(deps): Bump the all-go group across 2 directories with 4 updates by @dependabot[bot] in #5920
- bench(wash-runtime): add an ids microbenchmark for runtime UUID minting by @ricochet in #5927
- perf(wash-runtime): pool runtime UUIDs from one process-wide sequence by @vados-cosmonic in #5924
- release: v2.12.1 by @octo-sts[bot] in #5930
Full Changelog: v2.12.0...v2.12.1
